script_text: Stop, Taurus — the cosmos is locking onto your finances today and you need to pay attention. Mercury is forming a harmonious trine to your ruling planet Venus in your 2nd House of Wealth, grounding your Earth element's natural desire for stability, but Jupiter is clashing with a tense square in your 8th House of shared resources, creating serious tension between what you earn and what you owe. If you're single, a Capricorn energy will approach you with surprising honesty and raw vulnerability; if you're taken, a secret conversation about money could deeply shift your bond today. Your 10th House of career is highly activated — a promotion discussion lands today, but Venus strongly warns against accepting any rushed offers before the weekend. Avoid lending money to a family member before Wednesday or you'll deeply regret it. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week for Taurus.
